items.question: How do Indian IT companies get clients abroad?
items.answer: By narrowing to one or two capabilities they have already delivered, choosing one target market and running LinkedIn and cold email to the CTOs and engineering leaders there. For an Indian software development firm targeting US retail and logistics companies, this booked 24 meetings and 4 proposal requests beyond its referrals and project marketplaces.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: An in-house SDR costs you a full-time salary, months of ramp-up, and ongoing management. We give you a fully built outbound system, list building, sequences, and deliverability infrastructure, live within about three weeks, at a fraction of the cost and with none of the hiring risk.

items.question: We already have a team doing some outbound. Will this overlap?
items.answer: No. We plug into your existing motion and focus purely on ABM style cold email and LinkedIn outreach to net new accounts. Your team keeps doing what it does well, we add the top of funnel volume it does not have time for.

items.question: How fast will we start seeing meetings?
items.answer: Most agency and IT services clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, once ICP mapping, list building, sending domains and copy are ready. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, as messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: Do you work with the tools we already use, like our CRM?
items.answer: Yes, in the sense that everything we hand over fits your existing process. We don't build or manage CRM integrations; that stays with your team. Every qualified meeting and reply is passed to you directly, with the prospect's details and conversation history, so it is easy to log wherever you already track pipeline.

items.question: What does pricing and commitment look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.

items.question: What if the leads we get are not the right fit?
items.answer: We fix the targeting, not just the list. Your ICP is refined with you in the first two weeks, then adjusted every week based on who books calls and who converts. Leads that miss the profile are flagged and the pattern behind them is removed, so fit improves quickly instead of repeating.
